rules.sql: SELECT record_id, COUNT(*) FROM consumable.peer_comparison GROUP BY record_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
rules.rationale: record_id is a deterministic SHA-256 hash of the grain (cik, metric_id, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, metric_source). Duplicates indicate a computation or dedup guard bug.

rules.description: Every row has valid metric_source (company_financials or financial_ratios)
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consumable.peer_comparison WHERE metric_source NOT IN ('company_financials', 'financial_ratios')
rules.rationale: Only two metric sources exist. Unknown metric_source values indicate a build bug.

rules.description: Every row has valid cik (exists in source tables)
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consumable.peer_comparison pc WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM consumable.company_financials cf WHERE cf.cik = pc.cik) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM consumable.financial_ratios fr WHERE fr.cik = pc.cik)
rules.rationale: All peer comparison CIKs must exist in at least one source table. Orphan CIKs indicate a build bug.

rules.description: No null metric_value, sector_rank, sector_avg, sector_median, sector_percentile
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consumable.peer_comparison WHERE metric_value IS NULL OR sector_rank IS NULL OR sector_avg IS NULL OR sector_median IS NULL OR sector_percentile IS NULL
rules.rationale: Every peer comparison row must have all computed fields populated. Null values indicate the build pipeline failed to compute statistics.

rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consumable.peer_comparison WHERE sector_rank < 1 OR sector_rank > peer_count
rules.rationale: Dense ranking guarantees rank is between 1 and peer_count. Values outside this range indicate a ranking bug.

rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consumable.peer_comparison WHERE sector_percentile < 0.0 OR sector_percentile > 1.0
rules.rationale: The percentile formula produces values in [0.0, 1.0]. Values outside this range indicate a computation bug.

rules.description: peer_count >= 2 for every row (minimum peer threshold)
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consumable.peer_comparison WHERE peer_count < 2
rules.rationale: The build pipeline filters out groups with fewer than 2 companies. Any row with peer_count < 2 indicates the filter failed.

rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consumable.peer_comparison WHERE sector_rank = 1 AND sector_percentile != 1.0
rules.rationale: The percentile formula for rank 1 is (peer_count - 1) / (peer_count - 1) = 1.0. Any deviation indicates a computation bug.

rules.description: No single-company sectors (Energy, Industrials, Communication Services excluded)
rules.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM consumable.peer_comparison WHERE sector IN ('Energy', 'Industrials', 'Communication Services')
rules.rationale: These sectors have only 1 company each. Peer comparison requires 2+ companies. Any rows from these sectors indicate a filter bug.

rules.description: peer_count matches actual distinct CIKs per (sector, metric_id, fiscal_year, fiscal_period, metric_source)
rules.sql: SELECT pc.sector, pc.metric_id, pc.fiscal_year, pc.fiscal_period, pc.metric_source, pc.peer_count, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.cik) AS actual_count FROM consumable.peer_comparison pc GROUP BY pc.sector, pc.metric_id, pc.fiscal_year, pc.fiscal_period, pc.metric_source, pc.peer_count HAVING pc.peer_count != COUNT(DISTINCT pc.cik)
rules.rationale: peer_count is a denormalized aggregate. It must match the actual count of distinct CIKs for each group.
